name: @pipeworx/mcp-helsinki-events

tools.name: events
tools.description: Find upcoming events in Helsinki, Finland (City of Helsinki Linked Events). Filter by keyword, free admission, and date window. Returns events with venue, coordinates and tags. Text is shown in English where available (else Finnish).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-helsinki-events forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the helsinki-events pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
